_comment: Config-as-code: a ready-made widget entry to drop straight into a dashboard document's `widgets` array (the monolith's dashboards store). You normally do NOT need this — the Widget self-registers into the catalog (see ../catalog/widget-type.sql) and is added from the dashboard 'Add widget' menu. This file documents the exact shape the catalog produces: the `additionalConfig.remote` pointer triggers the monolith's generic RemoteWidget seam, which loads `src` and mounts `tag`. Registering/placing this Widget is data, not monolith code. See ../../docs/architecture/widget-microservice-fullstack.md.
